1. (Currently amended) A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin __derived from inulin having a molecular weight of at least 5000__; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F __and a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed __and the cement composition exhibits reduced water separation compared to cement compositions without carboxylated inulin__.

4. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition __at temperatures up to about 280 *F__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of __at least 5000__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin __having a degree of carboxymethyl substitution of from about 0.1 to about 0.3 and derived from inulin with a molecular weight of at least 5000__.
